chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from Zurʿah, from Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Concerning a man when he commits qadhf (false accusation of illicit sexual intercourse),
He said: "He is flogged with eighty lashes, whether he is free or enslaved."

key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, the number of lashes in this ruling
key_terms.قَذَفَ: to accuse someone of illicit sexual intercourse falsely
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is flogged as a prescribed legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for qadhf in Shia hadith, and does it differ between a free person and an enslaved person?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning qadhf, stating that the punishment is eighty lashes. It specifies that this hadd applies equally whether the offender is a free person or an enslaved person.
